run_p2p_simulation: run a config-driven P2P agent simulation using P2PAgentFramework with Hydra and Ray actors
create_scalable_team: create a ScalableTeamManager to manage multiple Ray actors per role with Dispatcher routing
create_agent_role: create agents for a role using ScalableTeamManager.create_role with an agent config and resources
run_parallel_actors: run multiple P2PAgentFramework Ray actors in parallel to split and process dataset chunks
shutdown_team: shutdown all Dispatchers and Sink actors using ScalableTeamManager.shutdown to send sentinels
